title: VooPoo UForce-L Tank
description: The Voopoo Uforce-L sub-ohm tank 2ml is a precision-engineered vape tank with adjustable, 3-inlet airflow control which not only lets you control how tight or loose your draw is but helps prevent leaks and the build-up of condensation. Heatsink technology also helps prevent your tank getting too hot, ensuring every puff is consistently comfortable. Voopoo’s Uforce-L sub-ohm tank is compatible with all of Voopoo’s versatile PnP series of coils and includes 1 x PnP - TW20 0.2ohm coil (recommended wattage range: 40-55W) and 1 x PnP- TW15 0.15ohm (recommended wattage range: 55-70W), and both feature dual-in-one mesh builds for fantastic flavour and cloud production. The tank features a 510 connection which lets you attach it to any compatible mod, as well as an 810-style drip tip that is replaceable. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
